name: Bandwidth-based Streaming Interval Calculation
definition: A method to calculate the minimum time interval between data fetches and the number of simulation slices to skip, based on system bandwidth limits to ensure real-time streaming from HDD to GPU.
summary: Bandwidth-based Streaming Interval Calculation dynamically adapts data fetch rates to hardware throughput, avoiding static partitioning by calculating safe skip counts for real-time volumetric streaming.
